title: Quadro ao Vivo — v2
demoData: Métricas e pares cidade/data são demonstrativos, não dados do Supabase.
prompt:
Render a high-fidelity screenshot mockup of a Portuguese operations dashboard on a 1600x1000 desktop canvas. Design direction: "Quadro ao Vivo", a period-aligned operations board with strong data table rhythm, crisp white and cool gray surfaces, dark navy typography, cobalt current selection, restrained warm yellow row highlight and fine row rules. It should look like a real internal operations web app with careful hierarchy, compact but readable. No airport metaphors, no browser chrome, no Safari or desktop frame, no status words beyond the supplied labels.

Preserve the current Dashboard Geral brand and functions. At top, show an app header with breadcrumb "Principal › Visão Geral" on the left; a persistent horizontal clipped ticker centered in the header, green refresh glyph and "Sincronizado", with scrolling city + date items "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09", a subtle left/right edge fade and chevrons to make horizontal scroll evident; theme and profile controls at right. These city/date items are illustrative placeholders, not live information. Keep the ticker visually separate from the filters.

Directly beneath the header, show a complete full-width filter module, two rows with unmistakable individual controls and labels. Row 1 has "Período", toggle "Ano/Semana" selected and "Intervalo", "Ano 2026", and a multiselect "Semana 05, 06, 07". Row 2 has four distinct selects "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", and an actionable-looking "Limpar" button. Do not collapse or hide any of the controls.

Below, use existing sidebar navigation text exactly: Principal (Visão Geral selected, Análise, UTR, Comparação), Operacional (Entregadores, Valores, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado), Marketing (Operacional Marketing, Marketing). Main title "Resumo Operacional", period caption "Ano 2026 · Semanas 05, 06, 07". Then three information blocks for "Corridas ofertadas" 18.450, "Aderência" 74,8%, and "Praças" 2. The table is the primary visual element, titled "Por praça" and shows headers Praça / Corridas / Aderência with rows Guarulhos / 11.230 / 76,1%; Centro / 7.220 / 72,8%; Total / 18.450 / 74,8%, one currently selected row indicated by a pale yellow band. Below or beside it include a compact but complete line chart "Evolução diária" with both "Ofertadas" and "Aceitas" legends. Keep all supplied text sharp and exact. All values are illustrative mock data. No fake data freshness or alerts except the supplied Sincronizado label.
